column1: # The pairings that put a small draft model in front of a larger target through
# llama.cpp's standalone draft path. One row per pairing; a router preset
# section named for the pair_id carries the target's full six-key tuple beside
# the draft keys, and remote/measure-draft-pair.sh measures a row against a
# same-session control of the target alone.
# The mechanism at f280b269 is `--spec-type draft-simple`.
# common/speculative.cpp maps that exact string onto
# COMMON_SPECULATIVE_TYPE_DRAFT_SIMPLE, tools/server/server-context.cpp builds a
# second common_params through common_base_params_to_speculative, which copies
# the draft's mparams, devices, n_gpu_layers, tensor overrides, and cache types
# over the target's, and common_speculative_init_result loads that path as a
# separate model with its own context. The draft context takes its depth from
# the target -- `cparams.n_ctx = llama_n_ctx(ctx_tgt)` -- so draft_context is
# the depth the runtime derives rather than a depth any argument sets, and the
# preset emits no key for it. The column records the derived value so a row
# states the allocation it asks the device for.
# common_speculative_impl_draft_simple calls common_speculative_are_compatible
# and throws when it fails, so a pairing is admitted on vocabulary identity
# rather than on architecture: matching vocab type, matching add_bos and
# add_eos with matching token ids, a token-count difference within
# SPEC_VOCAB_MAX_SIZE_DIFFERENCE of 128, and byte-identical token text from id
# 5 upward. evidence/model-admission/static-admission.tsv reports vocabulary
# size 248320, tokenizer_pre qwen35, and tokens_sha256
# Qwen3.5-0.8B and the Qwen3.8 distills alike, which is the identity the
# runtime check reduces to.
# spec_draft_n_max starts at 2 for both rows because
# evidence/mtp-speculation-matrix.md prices the target's verification pass by
# column count on this device. Its arm labels map to draft length through the
# S1 log line `n_max=1` beside the S1 table row `cols 2`, so a draft of N
# verifies N+1 columns; that mapping is inference from the two, not a figure
# either states. Columns one through four cost about 150 ms each and column
# five costs 536 ms, an occupancy step rather than a slope, so a draft of 4 or
# more lands past the cliff and S4 and S6 both decoded slower than no
# speculation at all. A draft of 2 verifies three columns, inside the measured
# flat region and one column clear of the step. The MTP head's draft pass cost
# 66.4 ms and the 0.8B's whole token time is 63 to 66 ms, so the draft half of
# the arithmetic transfers; the acceptance half does not, since a standalone
# draft is a different model rather than a head trained on the target's own
# hidden state.
# spec_draft_p_min is the probability floor below which the draft loop stops
# proposing. Both rows carry 0.00, the value every arm in the MTP matrix ran
# at, so the first pair arm changes the draft mechanism alone.
# tier carries the model registry's vocabulary and the same claims.
# build-router-presets.sh emits a section for a production or candidate row and
# for nothing else. validated_evidence names the directory holding the measured
# arm; `-` means no run has measured this pairing and the tier states that.
# pair_id
